cues.en: Mike: Now that you understand the one-sample t-test, it's time to learn about the two-samples t-test.
cues.zh: Mike：理解單一樣本 t 檢定後，現在學雙樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: And you'll see that the two-samples t-test is, on the one hand, it's a very simple extension of the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 一方面，它是單一樣本 t 檢定非常簡單的延伸。

cues.en: And in fact, the numerator for the two-samples t-test is something you can probably already come up with on your own before even watching the rest of this video.
cues.zh: 其實雙樣本 t 檢定的分子，可能在看完影片前，就能自己想出來。

cues.en: However, it turns out that the two-sample t-test gets pretty hairy in the denominator term.
cues.zh: 但分母變得相當棘手。

cues.en: The denominator term gets really weird and thick and complicated.
cues.zh: 分母會變得奇怪、冗長、複雜。

cues.en: And the denominator term actually depends on the characteristics of the groups that are under investigation.
cues.zh: 實際上取決於研究群組的特徵。

cues.en: So obviously, a two-samples t-test is for two samples when you have two groups.
cues.zh: 顯然，雙樣本 t 檢定用於兩個樣本、兩個群組。

cues.en: If you only have one group, then of course you're gonna be using a one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 只有一組，當然使用單一樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: So the purpose of a two-samples t-test is to test whether two sets of numbers, So two groups, in particular, we're focusing on the means.
cues.zh: 用途是檢驗兩組數字，尤其專注於平均值。

cues.en: So test whether the average of two groups of numbers could have been drawn from the same distribution.
cues.zh: 檢驗兩組數字的平均，是否可能來自同個分布。

cues.en: That's the null hypothesis that we are testing against.
cues.zh: 這是檢驗的虛無假設。

cues.en: So let's go through an example application.
cues.zh: 看個應用例子。

cues.en: Let's say we want to know whether six weeks of social distancing changes self-reported stress levels.
cues.zh: 假設想知道，六週社交距離措施，是否改變自陳壓力程度。

cues.en: So it's clearly important and societally relevant question to answer.
cues.zh: 顯然是重要、對社會有意義的問題。

cues.en: So what we do is, you know, let's say we get a group of people and we have them self-report their stress levels.
cues.zh: 找一群人，讓他們自陳壓力。

cues.en: So they just write down how stressed they feel at the very beginning of social distancing and after a month and a half of social distancing.
cues.zh: 在措施開始時，以及一個半月後，寫下感受到的壓力程度。

cues.en: Now, as I mentioned before, it's important in statistics to be able to talk about statistics in two ways.
cues.zh: 前面提過，統計中很重要的是，能用兩種方式談統計。

cues.en: One, you want to be able to talk about statistics to non-statisticians.
cues.zh: 第一，能和非統計專業的人談。

cues.en: So you want to be able to translate your experiments and your research questions and your results into a language that other people can understand.
cues.zh: 把實驗、研究問題和結果，轉成別人能理解的語言。

cues.en: But two, you also need to be able to speak very clearly about what exactly you are testing in the formal language of statistics.
cues.zh: 第二，也要能用正式統計語言，非常清楚說明究竟檢驗什麼。

cues.en: So in fact, we would actually, you know, this is what you would say, this is how you would explain the research to your grandmother unless your grandmother is a statistician,
cues.zh: 這是向祖母解釋研究的方式，除非祖母也是統計學家，

cues.en: in which case you would say something like this.
cues.zh: 那就會這樣說。

cues.en: So we are estimating the probability that self-reported stress levels before and after six weeks of social distancing were drawn from the same distribution.
cues.zh: 估計六週社交距離措施前後，自陳壓力程度來自同個分布的機率。

cues.en: This is the null hypothesis and we are testing the probability of observing the change in self-reported stress levels if the stress levels were drawn
cues.zh: 這是虛無假設；檢驗在壓力程度來自

cues.en: from the same distribution.
cues.zh: 同個分布時，觀察到壓力變化的機率。

cues.en: Okay, so it turns out that there are several distinct formulas for a two-samples t-test, and the good part is that the numerator is always the same.
cues.zh: 雙樣本 t 檢定有幾個不同公式，好消息是分子一直相同。

cues.en: And that's the part of the two-sample t-test formula that you can already come up with before I even show it to you on the next slide.
cues.zh: 這部分在下一張展示前，就可以自己想出來。

cues.en: The denominator, however, it is trickier.
cues.zh: 但分母比較棘手。

cues.en: It depends on whether the groups are paired or unpaired, whether the groups have equal or unequal variance, and whether the groups have matched or different sample sizes.
cues.zh: 取決於群組成對或不成對、變異數相等或不相等，以及樣本數相同或不同。

cues.en: Okay, so before showing you the formula, I'm going to explain what all these terms mean.
cues.zh: 展示公式前，先解釋這些術語。

cues.en: Because although it's not important to memorize all the formulas, it is important to memorize these terms and make sure you know which formula you need to apply.
cues.zh: 雖然不用記所有公式，但要記這些術語，知道該用哪個公式。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start with paired and unpaired.
cues.zh: 先談成對和不成對。

cues.en: So this term refers to whether the two groups of data are drawn from the same or different individuals.
cues.zh: 指兩組資料來自相同或不同個體。

cues.en: So in particular, a paired samples t-test means that the same individuals, well, this particular example,
cues.zh: 成對樣本 t 檢定表示，相同個體，在這個例子中，

cues.en: the same individuals self-report their stress levels before and after social distancing.
cues.zh: 同一批人在措施前後自陳壓力。

cues.en: So it's the same people, the same group, and we're measuring them twice.
cues.zh: 相同的人、相同群組，測量兩次。

cues.en: That would be paired.
cues.zh: 這就是成對。

cues.en: A paired samples t-test.
cues.zh: 成對樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: Unpaired t-test is if we are looking at the change in distancing related stress in just to pick two countries at random Denmark versus Singapore.
cues.zh: 不成對則例如比較兩個隨機選國家，丹麥和新加坡，社交距離相關壓力的變化。

cues.en: It doesn't matter that these are different countries, it matters that these are different individuals.
cues.zh: 國家不同不重要，重要的是個體不同。

cues.en: So here the two groups of data that we are comparing are within the same individual.
cues.zh: 這裡比較的兩組資料，來自同一個體之內。

cues.en: And here the two groups come from a different individual.
cues.zh: 這裡則來自不同個體。

cues.en: So it's a distinct set of people in Denmark versus Singapore.
cues.zh: 丹麥和新加坡是不同的一群人。

cues.en: You know, we could have also made this to be changes in stress in families with children versus families without children,
cues.zh: 也可以改成有小孩和沒有小孩的家庭，壓力變化的比較，

cues.en: or people who live alone versus people who live with a partner.
cues.zh: 或獨居者和與伴侶同住者。

cues.en: So that part doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 這部分不重要。

cues.en: The important thing is that a paired samples t-test means it's the same people and you test them multiple times before and after taking some medication
cues.zh: 重要的是，成對表示同一批人，多次測試，例如服藥前後，

cues.en: or you test their, I don't know, their how much time they spend on Reddit during the week versus during the weekend, and so on.
cues.zh: 或測量平日和週末花多少時間看 Reddit 等等。

cues.en: But it's always the same individuals.
cues.zh: 始終是相同個體。

cues.en: If it's an unpaired test, that means it's different individuals in the two groups.
cues.zh: 不成對表示兩組是不同個體。

cues.en: Okay, so that's paired and unpaired.
cues.zh: 這就是成對、不成對。

cues.en: Then we get to equal or unequal variance, and this is whether the two groups have roughly equal variance or not.
cues.zh: 再來是等變異數或不等變異數，指兩組變異數是否大致相同。

cues.en: So it turns out we need different formulas, different denominators in the t-test formula, depending on whether the groups have equal or unequal variance.
cues.zh: 依據變異數相等與否，需要不同公式、不同分母。

cues.en: And again, this is important, always important in statistics that we are talking about roughly equivalent, reasonably the same.
cues.zh: 統計中始終很重要的是，我們談的是大致相當、合理地相同。

cues.en: They don't have to be exactly numerically to, you know, 20 numbers of precision after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 不必數值精確到小數點後 20 位都一樣。

cues.en: As long as they're more or less comparable, then we can apply a simplified formula.
cues.zh: 只要大致可比較，就能套用簡化公式。

cues.en: Okay, so let me give you an example of equal variance.
cues.zh: 舉個等變異數的例子。

cues.en: Groups A and B are Caucasian 20-year-old students from the same university; group A studies engineering and group B studies computer science.
cues.zh: A、B 組都是同一所大學的 20 歲白人學生，A 組讀工程，B 組讀資訊科學。

cues.en: So first of all, is this a paired or unpaired t-test that we're working with here?
cues.zh: 首先，這是成對還是不成對 t 檢定？

cues.en: Well, I'm sure you got it right.
cues.zh: 相信你答對了。

cues.en: It is an unpaired t-test because these are different groups.
cues.zh: 不成對，因為是不同群組。

cues.en: So group A is engineering students, group B is computer science students.
cues.zh: A 組是工程學生，B 組是資訊科學學生。

cues.en: Okay, but that's actually not the question here.
cues.zh: 但這不是這裡的問題。

cues.en: The question here is whether we expect roughly comparable variance variability between these two groups.
cues.zh: 問題是，是否預期兩組有大致相當的變異程度。

cues.en: And in this case, I would say without even knowing anything about the specifics of the experiment, exactly what we're measuring here, I think the answer is going to be yes.
cues.zh: 這個情況，即使不知道實驗具體內容、量測什麼，我認為答案會是肯定的。

cues.en: We can assume that these two groups are going to have the same variability because look how similar they are to each other.
cues.zh: 可以假設兩組變異相同，因為看看有多相似。

cues.en: They have the same racial background, they're the same age, they're at the same university, and they have pretty comparable interests that they're studying.
cues.zh: 相同種族背景、相同年齡、同所大學，而且學習興趣相當接近。

cues.en: Engineering and computer science are pretty closely related to each other.
cues.zh: 工程和資訊科學關係很密切。

cues.en: Okay, contrast that with a case where we can expect unequal variance.
cues.zh: 比較一下，預期變異數不相等的情況。

cues.en: So let's say group A is this same group that I identified here and group B is a random sample of 20-year olds from across the country.
cues.zh: 假設 A 組仍是這一組，B 組則是全國隨機抽樣的 20 歲人群。

cues.en: Now the question is, do we expect group B to have the same variability as group A?
cues.zh: 預期 B 組變異會和 A 組相同嗎？

cues.en: And I think we can all agree that the answer is no.
cues.zh: 我想大家都同意，不會。

cues.en: Group A is probably gonna have very little variability because we are selecting a group of individuals that all have a lot in common.
cues.zh: A 組可能變異很小，因為選的是很多共同點的一群人。

cues.en: Group B doesn't have very much in common at all.
cues.zh: B 組則沒那麼多共同點。

cues.en: Particularly if they're randomly sampled, they have their age in common and their country in common, but otherwise they could have such different
cues.zh: 尤其隨機抽樣時，除了相同年齡、相同國家，可能有非常不同的

cues.en: socioeconomic backgrounds, educational backgrounds, interests, goals in life, and so on.
cues.zh: 社經背景、教育背景、興趣、人生目標等等。

cues.en: I don't think we should expect that these two groups will have the same amount of variability.
cues.zh: 不應預期兩組變異程度相同。

cues.en: All right, and then finally, I save the easiest one for last, equal or unequal sample size.
cues.zh: 最後，把最簡單的留到最後，樣本數相等或不相等。

cues.en: This obviously just refers to whether the groups have the same number of data points.
cues.zh: 顯然，就是兩組資料點數是否相同。

cues.en: So both groups have N equals 30, this would be equal sample size.
cues.zh: 兩組都是 N=30，就是樣本數相等。

cues.en: And an example of an unequal sample size is if we're doing some clinical research, we get 13 patients with Parkinson's disease and group B is 20 matched controls.
cues.zh: 不相等的例子，是臨床研究 A 組有 13 位帕金森氏症患者，B 組有 20 位配對條件相符的控制組個體。

cues.en: So the sample sizes are different between the two groups.
cues.zh: 兩組樣本數不同。

cues.en: And this also probably doesn't really need to be stressed, but this applies only to unpaired groups.
cues.zh: 大概不必強調，但這只適用於不成對群組。

cues.en: Obviously, when you have a paired sample t-test, then it's going to be the same number of data points because it's the same individuals.
cues.zh: 成對 t 檢定顯然資料點數相同，因為是同一批人。

cues.en: All right, so I mentioned that there are several different denominator terms depending on all of these characteristics of the data.
cues.zh: 提過分母有好幾種，取決於資料這些特徵。

cues.en: So here we have, oh my goodness, this is a ludicrously complicated formula.
cues.zh: 這裡，天啊，是個複雜得離譜的公式。

cues.en: This turns out to be one of several two-samples t-test formulas.
cues.zh: 這是雙樣本 t 檢定好幾種公式之一。

cues.en: Now let me first direct your attention to the numerator here because that's really simple.
cues.zh: 先看分子，因為很簡單。

cues.en: The numerator is just the mean of group one minus the mean of group two.
cues.zh: 第一組平均減第二組平均。

cues.en: It couldn't get easier than that.
cues.zh: 不能更簡單了。

cues.en: And this is the part of the formula that you could develop on your own.
cues.zh: 這部分可以自行推導。

cues.en: You could figure this out on your own.
cues.zh: 可以自己想出來。

cues.en: Okay, then we have the t-test with the denominator degrees of freedom, sorry, the degrees of freedom corresponding to the total sum of both groups.
cues.zh: 這裡 t 檢定的分母自由度，抱歉，是自由度，對應兩組樣本數總和。

cues.en: So n1 plus n2 minus 2.
cues.zh: 也就是 n₁+n₂−2。

cues.en: And it's minus 2 because we actually have two means here.
cues.zh: 減 2，是因為有兩個平均值。

cues.en: So this would be the degrees of freedom for group one would be n minus 1 and the degrees of freedom for group two would be n2.
cues.zh: 第一組自由度是 n−1，第二組是 n₂，

cues.en: So the number of people in group two minus 1.
cues.zh: 也就是第二組人數減 1。

cues.en: So you have n1 minus 1 plus n2 minus 2 gives us n1 plus n2 minus 2.
cues.zh: 所以 n₁−1 加 n₂−2，得到 n₁+n₂−2。

cues.en: All right, quite a mouthful there.
cues.zh: 好，說了很多。

cues.en: Okay, here is the denominator.
cues.zh: 這裡是分母。

cues.en: It's a lot of weird terms.
cues.zh: 有很多奇怪項目。

cues.en: This is the standard deviation square.
cues.zh: 這是標準差平方。

cues.en: So this is the sample variance from group one, the sample variance from group two, and one is the number of data points in group one
cues.zh: 也就是第一組樣本變異數、第二組樣本變異數；n₁ 是第一組資料點數，

cues.en: and n2 is the number of data points in group two.
cues.zh: n₂ 是第二組資料點數。

cues.en: Now a few things to stress here.
cues.zh: 有幾點要強調。

cues.en: One, please, please, please do not take the time to memorize this formula.
cues.zh: 第一，拜託不要花時間背這個公式。

cues.en: It doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 不重要。

cues.en: What I'm highlighting to you here is just the kind of complexity of the denominator terms for these two-samples t-test.
cues.zh: 只是強調雙樣本 t 檢定分母的複雜程度。

cues.en: In reality, you know, when you sit down to do your actual statistics, these things are all coded into whatever statistics package you're using.
cues.zh: 實際坐下來做統計時，這些都已寫進統計套件。

cues.en: Python, MATLAB, R, SPSS, SAS, you name it, they will all have this for you.
cues.zh: Python、MATLAB、R、SPSS、SAS，什麼都有。

cues.en: What you need to know is what the characteristics of your dataset are.
cues.zh: 需要知道的是，資料集的特徵。

cues.en: You need to know whether your data are paired or unpaired, equal or unequal variance, and matched or different sample sizes.
cues.zh: 成對或不成對、等或不等變異數、樣本數相同或不同。

cues.en: Once you know these, you can then select the correct formula and your statistical package will apply that correct formula for you.
cues.zh: 知道後，就能選正確公式，統計套件會替你套用。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I wanted to show you one of these t-test formulas, the complete formula just to give you a bit of a sense of what it looks like.
cues.zh: 但仍想展示一個完整公式，讓你稍微知道它的樣子。

cues.en: Now what I would like you to do after this video, I just have the closing slide here.
cues.zh: 影片後希望你做的是，這裡只剩結尾投影片，

cues.en: So in a minute what I would like you to do, get out a piece of paper and a pen, and write down this formula and simplify it as much as you can,
cues.zh: 等一下拿紙筆，寫下公式，盡可能簡化，

cues.en: assuming that we have equal N and equal variance.
cues.zh: 假設 N 相等、變異數相等。

cues.en: So basically work with this denominator and see what happens when you set n1 equals n2, and s1 squared equals s2 squared.
cues.zh: 基本上，處理這個分母，設定 n₁=n₂、s₁²=s₂²，看看會怎樣。

cues.en: And then just try to simplify this as much as you can.
cues.zh: 盡可能簡化。

cues.en: And it's interesting to see how the denominator of this two-samples t-test simplifies for different kinds of assumptions, different characteristics of the dataset.
cues.zh: 看看不同假設、不同資料特徵下，雙樣本 t 檢定分母如何簡化，很有趣。

cues.en: All right, so in this video, I covered the two-samples t-test.
cues.zh: 這部影片介紹雙樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: And the main point was that, on the one hand, the two-samples t-test is a simple extension of the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 主要重點是，一方面它是單一樣本 t 檢定的簡單延伸。

cues.en: Certainly in terms of the numerator.
cues.zh: 分子肯定如此。

cues.en: And the second important point was that the precise denominator that is appropriate for the t-test depends on the characteristics of the data groups.
cues.zh: 第二個重點是，適當的精確分母，取決於資料群組特徵。

cues.en: You do not need to memorize all these different formulas, but it is important for you to know which formula is appropriate based on whether your data are
cues.zh: 不用背下所有公式，但要知道根據資料是否

cues.en: paired or unpaired, have equal or unequal variances, and equal or unequal sample sizes.
cues.zh: 成對、變異數相等，以及樣本數相等，該使用哪個公式。
